entry: Official thprac v2.3.1.1, TH07 retail Normal Reimu A, Letty final spell Winter Sign Flower Wither Away, power 128, two spare lives, three Bombs. The policy receives camera plus its previous-frame difference and samples all four native action heads.
entry_qualification: One engineering original with exact selected section text and original HUD identification. Record 120 or more stable native clock, rank, shot, inventory and current/previous original key-slot witnesses. The engineering original supplies no optimizer inputs.
confirmation: A completed section requires an independently verified native final attack or stage-end transition and the original practice result screen. Preserve an official replay when the runtime produces one, with independent replay verification where supported. Retain the native original stage-record buffer and requested/consumed keys. Keep attack defeat, original timer completion, spell bonus, Game Over and experiment timeout as separately recorded events.

screening_gate.pass: At least one exact independently verified section completion in the eight registered physical starts releases collecting the remainder of approximately thirty original on-policy starts for a single PPO round. Aggregate the original eight and classifiable additional starts from the same frozen policy.
screening_gate.no_success: With zero verified completions, use a fresh separately registered set of eight late-section training starts with additional original practice resources. Record initial resources from the original and keep full-stock evaluation separate. Require witnessed completion before committing to thirty experiments.

reward: Keep gamma .999, progress and spare-life potential. A verified section completion uses +1 plus gamma times the true remaining active and spare lives at the boundary, with zero continuation after the objective. Game Over has zero terminal value. A physically playable experiment cap receives current fold critic bootstrap on its exact next camera.
optimizer: Camera-only joint four-head PPO from the frozen on-policy actor, at most 0.01 mean joint KL. Begin only after observed original objective positives and train/held source disjointness are verified.
held_and_progression: Use twenty separate held originals per arm with matching scene, rank, stock, power and absence of Continues. Move the starting point to the previous original attack only if the candidate completes at least 50% and improves by at least twenty percentage points against the frozen parent. Stop expanding that section after two unsuccessful optimization rounds. Clean original Normal Game Start controls the independent Stage 2 and full-credit milestones.
